'''Tournament decklist sheets''' record the cards a player registers for a [[Tournament|tournament]]. The Players Committee's paper forms have used the same 60 numbered lines for the main deck, with different fields for cards that start outside it.

! Form
! What players could record

| In addition to the 60 numbered card lines, the form has 15 separate Defensive Shield lines.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/decklist-form-bw.pdf 2015 Players Committee decklist form].</ref>
|-
| 2017
| [[:File:PC-2017-Decklist-II-fill.pdf|Fillable Players Committee form]]
| The form keeps the 60 main-deck lines. Its '''Additional Cards''' area names Jabba's Prize (V) and Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize and supplies two blank entries. The dedicated Defensive Shield lines were removed.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Decklist-II-fill.pdf 2017 Players Committee fillable decklist form].</ref>
|}

In November 2016 the Players Committee removed the numeric stack limit for the two Virtual Set 0 [[Starting Effect|Starting Effects]] and announced that Defensive Shields no longer had to be listed on the tournament decklist form. [[Defensive Shield#Starting Effect limits]] describes the earlier caps and the wording change.
